change: Encode canonical v7 entries without per-field CRC updates; CRC the complete contiguous encoded stream once. Keep v5/v6 streaming CRCs, v4, digest format, and scheduling behavior.
schedule: One unscored warmup per arm, then three alternating triplets per cell. Both screen cells complete regardless of performance. Run all four guards only if both screens pass. No score-selected replacements or additional retries.
ranking: Highest-throughput eligible scored invocation per exact binary and workload; p99 is from that same invocation. Report unfiltered maxima and every raw invocation too. Historical matching-binary best scores remain separate.

stall_filter.selection: Independently exclude obvious stalls per arm; no requirement that its same-round control qualifies. Aggregate means can miss stalls.

cpu_policy: Diagnostic only, never a retention veto.
constraints: No benchmarks overlap builds, tests, profiles, source edits, or other benchmarks.
All scratch databases under the local repo and removed after capture.
On failure or inconclusive outcome save full patch and exact binary, restore retained Rust with fresh mtimes and canonical binary atomically, then run a fresh full check.
Retained source optimization and evidence use separate commits.
